name: WI-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Gwen Moore running for reelection
Polymarket prices Moore at 97% to win
Republican challenger has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: Milwaukee-based WI-04 is a D+26 seat with a long-serving incumbent, and prediction markets price Moore's chances near 97% with no visible challenger fundraising. The fundamentals-based margin of roughly 27 points fits comfortably with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: Any credible polling or a well-funded challenger emergence would be the first sign of movement, but nothing currently suggests this seat is in play.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Gwen Moore seeks another term in this Milwaukee-based House district, one of the most Democratic-leaning seats in Wisconsin with a partisan lean of D+26. She has raised over $1 million for the race, while Republican Tim Rogers reports no fundraising activity and an independent candidate is on the ballot with no visible resources. No general-election polls are available, and no expert raters have flagged the race as competitive.

Prediction markets give Moore roughly a 97% chance of winning, consistent with the district's fundamentals and her incumbency advantage. With no outside spending against her and a large financial edge, the race is rated Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty being the absence of polling rather than any evidence of competition.
